message.content: It depends on what you’re looking for—genre, critical acclaim, or audience reception—but many critics and audiences agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was still dominating conversations into 2020, especially after its historic Oscar wins. If you’re looking for something released strictly in 2020, **“Tenet”** (2020) was a high‑profile blockbuster, while indie fans often pointed to **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** (2020) as a standout political drama. For a heartfelt family film, **“Soul”** (2020) received widespread praise for its animation and emotional depth. Ultimately, the “best” movie will vary with your taste, but those titles were among the most talked‑about and critically lauded releases of that year.
